# netbox_virtual_circuit_termination (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/circuits/virtualcircuittermination/):

> A virtual circuit termination connects an interface to a virtual circuit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_virtual_circuit_termination" "example" {
  virtual_circuit_id = netbox_virtual_circuit.example.id
  interface_id       = netbox_device_interface.example.id
  role               = "peer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface_id` (Number) The ID of the interface associated with the virtual circuit termination.
- `virtual_circuit_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual circuit associated with the virtual circuit termination.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the virtual circuit termination.
- `role` (String) One of [peer, hub, spoke].
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_virtual_circuit_termination.example 1
```
